<@ba.vup>+50</> RES; If equipped by a [Kjerag] Operator, enemies within Attack Range that are <$ba.cold>Cold</> or <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> take <@ba.vup>30%</> of equipped Operator's ATK as Arts damage per second
